lines.text: Precipitation refers to all forms of water that fall from the clouds. There are different processes
that lift moist air upwards to form clouds. Consequently different types of the clouds formed at
different altitudes.These clouds produce diverse forms of precipitation.
i. Drizzle: It is liquid form of precipitation consisting of very small drops of water.Approximate
droplet size of thedrizzle is less than 0.5mm.
i. Rain: Rainfall is the most common form of precipitation. It consists of drops of liquid water.
iv.Sleet:When the precipitation isin theformofamixture ofrainand snow, itisreferredto assleet.
v.Hail:This is the solid form of precipitation; it consists of hard rounded pellets or irregular
lumps of ice Hailstones are usually composed of roughly concentric layers ofice.
